derivation.final: Immediately after the pulse lies an interval of length Tf=128, followed by positive stage lengths. Thus Xplus<Xv*exp(128)<Xb.

analyticPremises.totalStressMoments: Original (5.19)-(5.21): the executed five-moment inverse and the complete I2 heat compensation give zero total residual integrals. Thus the retained forward stress equals its backward primitive; a compact integrand alone is never declared to have zero integral.
analyticPremises.terminalReduction: On X>=Xb*exp(-1/4), all earlier stages/repairs have ended and the heat cutoff is one. The matched terminal pressure density has positive square root Ecl. Therefore F0=Fheat*fo, with Fheat the same complete Laplace heat factor.
analyticPremises.completeHeatSmoothness: For every fixed j>=0 and Z>=0, (-1)^j H^(j)(Z)=(h)_j/Gamma(1+h)*Integral_0^infinity exp(-v)*v^(h+j)*(1+Zv)^(-h-j)dv. Positive gamma moments and integration by parts give |H^(j)|<=(h)_j*(1+h)_j<=j!*(j+1)!. This dominates all finite mixed derivatives on the closed compact X/eta rectangle, including eta=+/-1; the improper tail is retained.
analyticPremises.endpointSmoothness: The original square-seed cutoff is flat at both endpoints. Every fixed derivative of exp(-4/delta^2) times a finite inverse power tends to zero at delta=0.
